terms.gloss: a prized fish, probably the sturgeon
evidence: Hor. S. 2.2.47: Gallōnī praecōnis erat acipēnsere mēnsa īnfāmis (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: Lewis & Short writes acipenser, “not accipenser”, the spelling Traupman prints; it is “perhaps the sturgeon”, a luxury fish.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency (printed page numbers): p. 387.
Horace checked against the Perseus Latin text.
